title: cert.rs: silently ignoring DER encode failure of signer_cert subject in cycle detection
description: In build_chain(), lines 105-107: 'if let Ok(s) = signer_cert.tbs_certificate().subject().to_der() { visited.insert(s); }'. If the DER encode of signer_cert's subject fails, nothing is inserted into visited. This means signer_cert is not protected against cycle detection. A subsequent bag cert with the same subject (a genuinely unusual situation) would not be detected as a cycle. More critically, the DER failure is silently swallowed — no warning, no error. For other DER encode failures in the same function (issuer, parent subject), errors are propagated. The inconsistency is surprising. Either propagate the error or document why this specific failure is safe to ignore.
